des-aubris.name: Zenaida des Aubris
des-aubris.now: Founder of Opera Career Coach, Berlin — advising conservatoires, competitions and young singers on how to build and manage a career.
des-aubris.cv: Born in Argentina, with more than thirty-five years in artist management and classical music production across the United States, Europe and Asia. She began in the artistic administration of San Francisco Opera under Kurt Herbert Adler, then became personal manager to the director Jean-Pierre Ponnelle (1980–1988) and to Lorin Maazel (1993–1997). In 1997/98 she was General Project Manager of Puccini's Turandot in the Forbidden City in Beijing, conducted by Zubin Mehta and directed by Zhang Yimou. From 2002 to 2004 she was the first General and Artistic Director of the newly built Hangzhou Grand Theatre in China, and afterwards led artistic administration for the opening seasons of the Palau de les Arts in Valencia.

danish.name: Peter Danish
danish.now: Classical Music Editor in Chief at BroadwayWorld Classical, New York — critic, author and media marketing consultant.
danish.cv: Two decades of senior marketing leadership in American television: Director of Marketing at NBC, Vice President of Marketing at Telemundo, Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing at Azteca, and marketing consultant to PBS. Alongside that he has programmed concerts and education projects for arts organisations including American National Opera and Westchester Hudson Opera, and lectures on opera in schools and libraries. He is a classical music critic in New York, a best-selling author, and a member of the Dramatists Guild and the Music Critics Association of North America.

grigorev.name: Alex Grigorev
grigorev.now: Director of Artist Management at TACT Artists Management, Amsterdam.
grigorev.cv: TACT is one of Europe's leading vocal agencies and works with IMG Artists through a strategic alliance of their vocal departments. As a director of the agency he signs and places singers across the international house and festival circuit — the side of the profession that decides which young voices are heard, and when.

pokkinen.name: Lauri Pokkinen
pokkinen.now: Development Manager at the Foundation for the Finnish Museum of Architecture and Design, Helsinki.
pokkinen.cv: Musicologist and arts manager. He studied musicology, marketing and management at the University of Helsinki and the Freie Universität Berlin and holds a master's degree in musicology from Helsinki. He was a producer at the Helsinki Festival and Musica nova Helsinki, then the first audience outreach and social responsibility manager at the Finnish National Opera and Ballet, later its External Relations Manager. His subject is the one most academies leave out: how an audience is actually won.

sorrentino.name: Ambra Sorrentino
sorrentino.now: Founder and CEO of Opera Co-Pro, the international marketplace for opera co-productions, active in more than thirty-six countries.
sorrentino.cv: Opera manager and cultural entrepreneur, trained as a harpist (diploma 110/110 cum laude) with a master's degree in International Management of Opera Theatres. Stations include Teatro San Carlo in Naples, Oper Leipzig, Teatro Goldoni, the Puccini Festival, artistic leadership roles in Ingolstadt and at the Hamburger Kammeroper, Robert Gilder & Co in London and New York, and project management at Theater Magdeburg. She sits on juries of international singing competitions and is an EU expert for culture.

friedmann.name: Lidia Friedmann
friedmann.now: Vocal coach for emerging opera singers — technique, language and interpretation.
